title: Skill Anatomy Labeler
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI for EE Research
description: Labeling activity on the enob-report agent skill. The skill's directory tree and SKILL.md are shown, and eight lines or files are highlighted one at a time in a fixed order. For each, the learner commits one of four labels (Skill name, Skill description, Skill instructions, Supporting file) and receives feedback naming the correct label with a one-sentence reason. The final score is reported as n of 8 correct, and mastery is 7 of 8.

educational.topic: The parts of an agent skill
learningObjectives: Identify, for each of eight lines or files of a skill, whether it is the skill name, the skill description, skill instructions, or a supporting file, with at least 7 of 8 correct

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; the label menu and the buttons are native HTML controls reachable with the Tab key. The highlighted item is marked by an outline and a pointer glyph as well as a fill color, and feedback uses a check mark or X and the words Correct or This is a, not color alone. Colors are from the Okabe-Ito palette.

controls.label: Choose a label
controls.purpose: Choose Skill name, Skill description, Skill instructions, or Supporting file for the highlighted item. Locked after submit.

controls.label: Submit
controls.purpose: Commits the chosen label for the highlighted item; one attempt per item. Enabled once a label is chosen.

controls.label: Next item
controls.purpose: Replaces Submit after an item is answered and highlights the next item.

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Shown after item 8; clears all answers and highlights item 1 again.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Labeling the parts of a single realistic example, with one attempt per item and an explanatory reason after each
keyQuestions: Which part of the skill is this?
Is this inside SKILL.md or a separate file?
Is this line in the frontmatter or the body of SKILL.md?
commonMisconceptions: The description only says what the skill does and not when to use it
Scripts and templates are part of SKILL.md
The name and the description are the same thing
assessmentOpportunities: Score on the single attempt for each of the eight items; mastery is at least 7 of 8 correct
Write a description line for a skill of your own that says what it does and when to use it
